name: Steps
description: A numbered list that shows where the user is in a multi-step process, such as checkout, and which steps are done or still to come. Mark the current step with aria-current="step".
summary: Shows progress through a multi-step process

elements.name: Step marker
elements.description: Number or check icon showing the step's position and state

elements.name: Description
elements.description: Extra line under the label, usually in vertical layouts

configOptions.options: Below the marker, Beside the marker
Full list, Current step and count only
Static, Links back to the step

variants.caption: Labels below — markers in a row
Count only — current step name and "Step 2 of 4"

usageNotes: Use an <ol> so the number of steps and each step's position are announced, and put aria-current="step" on the current one.
Show completed, current and upcoming states with text or icons as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1), for example visually hidden "Completed" text in each finished step.
Make completed steps links only if users can safely go back to them. Upcoming steps should not be links.
Steps shows position in a process. For the share of a task that is done, use a Progress bar; for dated events, use a Timeline; for a quantity with + and − buttons, use a Number input.
A long row of steps rarely fits on a small screen. Switch to the vertical layout, or show only the current step and the count.
